title.en: Ask the device what it can do, then dry-run against its own answer

goal.en: An agent should not assume a device from a catalog. Read the capability document from the Core API and pass it to the dry run as the device, so the plan is made against what the device itself declared.

note.en: The hub's device: the example arm with cut, crack and transfer.
Shakshuka against the device's own document, a person present: the arm cuts, the person cooks.
Koshari against the same document: the arm cuts the onions; the person does the other nineteen steps, including the frying.

outcome.en: Your agent plans against the live device, never a cached idea of it, and can say which steps it will ask the household to do. Scenario 018 shows what happens when the agent then sends a request.
